purpose: Offline, aggregate-only confidence diagnostics. Confidence remains noncanonical and no output is a score, coverage, calibration, or promotion decision.
limits: Leave-one-repeat-out consensus is an empirical proxy, not human truth; tied leave-out labels are excluded before Brier, ECE, and reliability calculations.
Fresh88 and Grok HANNA association is not leaf-level calibration and must not emit Brier, ECE, or reliability claims.
Confidence effects are reported only as role-stratified YES-rate and effective-confidence-mass diagnostics, never confidence-weighted HBQ scores or coverage.
Equal-budget resampling is conditional on a complete rectangular repeat matrix, uses an abstaining tie rule, and is descriptive only.
Fresh88 reports dimension-specific mapped HBQ/HANNA associations separately for the 80 generated-story primary and the all-88 secondary.
